name: paseo-team
description: 按主控选择默认团队、单开发者实现与按需多成员审查的 Paseo Skill

scripts.format: prettier --write README.md "skills/paseo-team/**/*.md" "skills/paseo-team/scripts/*.mjs" docs/verification.md package.json package-lock.json scripts/check.mjs "tests/*.test.mjs" .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml "skills/paseo-team/agents/*.yaml"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md "skills/paseo-team/**/*.md" "skills/paseo-team/scripts/*.mjs" docs/verification.md package.json package-lock.json scripts/check.mjs "tests/*.test.mjs" .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml "skills/paseo-team/agents/*.yaml"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run syntax && npm run check:skill
scripts.syntax: node --check scripts/check.mjs && node --check skills/paseo-team/scripts/workflow.mjs && node --check tests/check.test.mjs && node --check tests/workflow.test.mjs && node --check skills/paseo-team/scripts/team.mjs && node --check tests/team.test.mjs
